name: terminal
description:
Run shell commands on the shell named in your environment section. The working directory, files and exported variables persist between calls: activate a virtualenv or export once, not before every command.

Use read_file, search_files, patch and write_file instead of cat/head/tail, grep/find/ls, sed/awk and echo/heredoc. Long output is truncated to its head and tail with the full text saved to a file whose path is in the result; never pipe through head/tail to shorten it.

Foreground (default) returns as soon as the command finishes. To wait a fixed time, run the wait in the foreground; never background a sleep or polling loop. Background is only for commands that must keep running after this call returns; health-check a server in a separate call and manage jobs with process_manage. When a command changes directory, trust the result's "cwd" instead of prefixing later commands with cd. A foreground command that times out is killed and the shell restarts in the same directory (exported variables are lost).

background.description: Keep running after this call returns; returns a session_id.

timeout.description: Max seconds for a foreground command (default 180, max 600). Finishing early returns at once, so set it generously.

workdir.description: Absolute working directory for this command only.

notify.description: With background=true: send one notification when the process exits. Use it for anything that ends (builds, tests, deploys); omit for servers/daemons.
